THEKWINI
(TVET) COLLEGE
@thekwinitvetcollege

The National Certificate Vocational “NCV” is a programme at each of the National Qualification
Framework (NQF) levels of study. It will take three years to complete the full (NQF L2/3/4)
qualification. Designed as high quality, high knowledge programmes to provide the out of school
youth and post grade 9 learners with the option to jumpstart their careers by beginning at (Grade
10) Level 2. The NCV qualifications will involve practical and workshop type training. Students who

have completed an NCV qualification will be eligible for employment in their chosen fields of study
or articulation to Higher Education institutions.

MINIMUM ENTRY REQUIREMENTS:
16 years or older and a pass in Grade 9 or higher or an NQF level 1 qualification.
COURSES OFFERED
Engineering & Related Design: Automotive Repair And Maintenance
This deals with the fundamentals of vehicle technology and equips students with the necessary
confidence to perform tasks related to vehicle components-engines, gearboxes, fuel systems,
body components and electronics.
Electrical Infrastructure Construction
This programme covers both heavy and light current fields. Learners are eligible to access careers
in Electrical Engineering, domestic/Industrial/electrical maintenance, digital electronics,
instrumentation and self-supporting enterprises.
Engineering & Related Design: Fitting & Turning
Fitting and turning deals with the various processes involved in making or producing components
required in the manufacturing, engineering and technological environment.
Engineering & Related Design: Fabrication
Engineering Fabrication involves making or producing steel components required in the
manufacturing, engineering and technological environments.
Information Technology and Computer Science
Information technology and computer science programme covers the interpretation of software
applications, networking, I.T principles and data processing.
Hospitality
This learning programme covers sectors of the tourism and hospitality industries. It provides
learners with marketable skills to enter the hospitality industry placing emphasis on the importance
of client satisfaction for revenue generation.
Tourism
Covers skills such as map reading, forex conversions and tour guidance. It also concepts such as
sustainability, heritage and conservation and helps to form the foundation of successful tourism
practice.
Transport & Logistics
Logistics is the planning, organisation, management, execution and control of freight transport
operations. It integrates individual transport acts to door-to-door supply chains, determining the
efficiency of freight transport.
Office Administration
This programme involves planning, organizing and the execution of office duties and
administration the business environment.
Educational and Development
This qualification is designed to provide both the theory and practice of Education and
Development. It will provide students with the practical component of study which may be offered
in a real work space environment.
PRE-VOCATIONAL LEARNING PROGRAMME

This programme is designed to assist candidates/learners who do not meeti the minimum APS
required for entry into the NC(V) Programmes. Candidates are referred to study PLP in order to
improve their subject achievement levels. ( This is a one year programme- Subjects are
English,Mathematics, Science, Life Skills- including Technology)
REPORT 191 (‘N’ COURSES) AND OTHER PROGRAMMES

The NATED / Report 191 programmes are delivered under the auspices of the Department of
Higher Education and Training and quality assured by Umalusi. The programmes consist of 18
months theoretical studies at a TVET College and 18 months relevant practical application in work
places. Engineering studies range from N1-N6 while Business and Utility Studies range from
N4-N6.
*Engineering Study Courses are trimester programmes (3 months per level)
*Business Study Courses are semester programmes (6 months per level)
DURATION: 1 Year for N1 – N3 Engineering Studies / 1 Year for
N4 – N6 Engineering Studies
3 Years (18 months theoretical studies + 18 months’ workplace application) for
N4 – N6 Business and Utility Studies

ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS:
Engineering Studies- Grade 12 pass (N2/N3 admission- dependent on Mathematics and Science
marks)
Business Studies-Grade 12 pass for N4 admission.
Bursaries: are available for financially and academically qualifying students.

Terms and Conditions apply to all Admission Requirements, Bursaries and other enrolment and
registration procedures.
